description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android wearable quiz application. The class manages quiz questions, user interactions, communication with Google Play Services for Android Wear devices, and updates to the UI based on quiz progress and data received from the wearable device. It handles creating questions, initiating data items for questions, tracking quiz state, and synchronizing with the wearable's notifications and responses.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity manages the quiz logic, UI, and communication with wearable devices. It allows creating questions, updating their status after answering, resetting the quiz, handling data and message events from the wearable, and coordinating data items for questions.

classes.name: MainActivity.Question
classes.description: Represents a quiz question, including the text, choices, correct answer index, and methods for JSON parsing and converting to DataApi requests. Implements Comparable to sort questions by index.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI components, and GoogleApiClient; sets up initial state.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Connects GoogleApiClient if not already connected.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Removes listeners, sends quiz end data, and disconnects GoogleApiClient.

methods.name: onConnected
methods.description: Registers data and message listeners.

methods.name: onConnectionSuspended
methods.description: Placeholder for handling suspension; currently ignores suspension.

methods.name: onConnectionFailed
methods.description: Logs connection failure.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, notably reset commands.

methods.name: readQuizFromFile
methods.description: Loads questions from a local JSON file and adds them to the quiz.

methods.name: addQuestion
methods.description: Creates a new question from user input, adds it to data items, and updates the UI.

methods.name: addQuestionDataItem
methods.description: Enqueues or immediately sends a question as a DataItem for the wearable notification.

methods.name: setNewQuestionStatus
methods.description: Displays the initial status for a new question.

methods.name: onDataChanged
methods.description: Processes incoming DataEvent updates about question answers or deletions, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: updateQuestionStatus
methods.description: Updates UI to reflect whether a question was answered correctly or incorrectly, adjusting counts.

methods.name: markQuestionLeftBlank
methods.description: Marks a question as skipped or left unanswered when its notification is deleted.

methods.name: askNextQuestionIfExists
methods.description: Triggers the next question if available; otherwise signals quiz completion.

methods.name: sendMessageToWearable
methods.description: Sends a message via Data Layer to connected wearables.

methods.name: resetQuiz
methods.description: Resets the UI and data items, clearing the current quiz state.

methods.name: resetDataItems
methods.description: Resets data items based on current data buffer, marking questions as unanswered.

methods.name: deleteDataItems
methods.description: Deletes listed data items from the Data Layer.

methods.name: setHasQuestionBeenAsked
methods.description: Sets internal flag to determine if a question has been asked; enables/disables buttons accordingly.
